name: Portobello Mushroom Flatbread with Sun-Dried Tomato Pesto & Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 caps portobello mushrooms
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Remove mushroom stems, cut caps into ¼-inch thick slices, and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with vinaigrette, season with salt and pepper, then toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp balsamic vinaigrette
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mushrooms in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until golden brown and tender, 10-12 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, divide flatbreads between two additional large baking sheets. Add to the oven and bake, flipping halfway through, until slightly crispy, 8-10 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the mushrooms are done, assemble the flatbreads. Spread a thin layer of pesto over each flatbread, then top with cheese, mushrooms, and Italian seasoning.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup sun-dried tomato pesto
1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend
¾ tsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Return flatbreads to the oven and bake until warmed through and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes. Place in a large bowl along with spinach and vinaigrette; toss to combine the salad.
Slice flatbreads and divide between plates. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
